support_story_1_headline: Ka joma loso gikmoko dhi nyime, oganda ng’ado bura.
support_story_1_lead: Rito masin mari kuom obadho mag hardwaya ma ok oling' kod lokruok ma okethore.
support_story_1_body: Innioasis kinde ka kinde golo program manyien mag jotugo kaka Y1 (ma keto pachgi kuom loso board ma opondo kaka 6.0, 7.0, kod 8.0) ma ketho gik machon e yo ma ok oling’. Gima rach moloyo en ni, websait margi ok chiw ng’ato ang’ata ma nyalo ng’ado bura kendo onge ng’at ma nyalo donjo e program ma ne tiyo chon mondo oyud dwoko bang’ bedo e chal ma ne okethore. CE ma loso gik manyien kod chenro mar Firmware mar Oganda kawo gik moko: waketo ROM moro amora machon, wanono giwegi ni iloso gik ma itiyogo, kendo waketo gik ma itiyogo tiyo maber.
support_story_1_item_1: Reso Jotugo Mokethore: Nonro mag arita neno ni lokruok manyien ok keth hardware machon.
support_story_1_item_2: ROM mag stok moketi: Chokruok moduto mar program mag kambi machon mag Innioasis oseruchi.
support_story_1_item_3: Platform mopogre opogre: Gigo ma rieny chuth mag macOS, Linux, kod Windows kaka gimoro achiel.
support_story_1_item_4: Rieko mar hardware: Ong’eyo board owuon mondo kinde duto iyud gik ma owinjore.
support_story_2_headline: Onge Draiva mag Google ma okethore. Onge tich mar paro. Firmware ma tiyo kende.
support_story_2_lead: Gik ma ng’ato nyalo timo mapiyo kendo ma osetimne nonro ma inyalo geno kuomgi.
support_story_2_body: Luoro program mar Innioasis ma oyangore thothne tiende en rango mbui mag mbui ma oserumo, mbui ma osetho mag Baidu, kod fainde mag zip maonge gigo ma rieny. Ne waloso mbui ma nyalo yie kendo ma nigi SHA-256 ma owinjore, lendo mag loso, kod keto gik moko e okang’ ka okang’. Gik ma imiyo rito gik ma iting’o kod gik ma itiyogo ma miyo mano bedo nyalore kuom seche 24 e odiechieng’, ndalo 365 e higa.
support_story_2_item_1: CDN ma ng’ato nyalo ng’ado mapiyo kendo ma onge giko mar ng’ado kata link ma tho.
support_story_2_item_2: Update Ong’eyo: Yud ng’eyo e kinde ma gik manyien ma oganda golo kata gik ma oloso.
support_story_2_item_3: Gik ma Iketo e Okang’ ka Okang’ ma Otelne: Gik ma nenore maler biro konyi e kinde ma idiyo baton moro amora.
support_story_2_item_4: Oganda ma wuoyo dhok mang’eny: Owinjore gi dho Ingresa, dho China, dho Jamani, dho Spain, dho Faransa kod dho Japan.
support_story_3_headline: <2Zepa> Yawo nyalo duto mar jatugo mari mar Innioasis.
support_story_3_lead: Kelo Rockbox, sistem mag tiyo gi mbui mayot molosi kaka idwaro, kod uhuru mar jowinjo.
support_story_3_body: Program mag kambi mag stok ng’ado mana gik ma hardwaya mari mar Y1 kata Y2 nyalo timo. Ogandawa nokelo Rockbox, sistem ma yot mar tiyo gi kompiuta, thum mar kodek mar jogo ma ohero winjo, kod thum ma olosi e ngima. Wanyiewo gik mopogore opogore mag hardware ma nenore gi pesa ma ok wanyal ng’iewo mondo watem, walok injinia, kendo wabed gi adier kuom gik moko duto ma iketo. Chiwo siro Update chiwo omwom achiel kachiel ne yunit mag pim gi kendo miyo loso mapiyo program mag kompyuta ma ng'ato dwaro.
support_story_3_item_1: Rockbox ma itimo gi klik achiel: Weche ma iwinjo kod thum ma iketo e sekon moko.
support_story_3_item_2: Firmware mar Oganda: Bedo mag betri, UI maler, kod kony mar kodek mar dwol ma nyasani.
support_story_3_item_3: Lab mar gik ma tiyo: Watimo temo kuom gik ma nenore adier kapok wagolo gimoro amora ma waloso.
support_story_3_item_4: Program ma onge chudo: 100% program ma onge chudo, program ma rito siri mokuongo ma onge lendo kata luwo.
support_story_4_headline: Konywa timo gik ma jo Inniosis ok tim.
support_story_4_lead: Firmware matiyo gi teko mar oganda rito masinde magi mondo kik odonjre e kar bolo yugi.
support_story_4_body: Ka kambi moro ma loso gige tich dhi nyime gi gige tich maluwo, gik machon iweyo. Innioasis ok chiw ng’eyo moro amora mar Linux, ok chiw lokruok ma nenore maler, kendo ok chiw yo mayot mar dwoko gimoro ka ng’ato oketo gimoro marach. Updater nitie nikech jogo ma nigi gombo mar tiyo kode ok onego obolo gimoro maber ahinya mar thum. 100% mar chiwo mag oganda dhi achiel kachiel e keto gino ma itiyogo obed ma oyawore ne ji duto.
support_story_4_item_1: Reso & Weyo Brick: Resruok ma onyis ni ng’ato nyalo yudo kata ka masinde ok oyie chako.
support_story_4_item_2: Suport mar Klasi Mokwongo mar Linux: Suport chuth mar MediaTek ma rieny e mbui mag Linux.
support_story_4_item_3: Oboke mag lokruok ma nenore maler: Oboke ma oting’o weche mathoth mag golo mondo ing’e maber ni gin ang’o ma lokore.
support_story_4_item_4: 100% Oting’o Pesa mag Oganda: Kofi moro amora miyo kar keno bedo ma oyawore kendo ma ji duto yudo maonge chudo.

err_flash_write_failed_desc: Ne okethore kata tich mar ndiko ne ok odhi maber. Rang ni kebo mar USB oket maber kendo ni betri nigi chaja moromo, kae to tem kendo.
err_mtk_output_stall_desc: Gima rieny osenyiso line maromre kuom sekon {seconds} mokalo kendo ok oneno ni odhi nyime ndiko program mar ng’ato. Nyalo bedo ni flash nosetho. Kapo ni mano ne en temo mogik kuom temo ariyo ma yo ka yo moro ka moro nigo e sistem ma nyalo dok chien e kindgi, kata kapo ni MTKClient kende ema yudore e masinni, chak kompyuta kendo tem kendo.

prompt_restart_and_quit_desc: Nyalo bedo ni flash nosetho. Yie mondo isom ote ma ni e wi wachno kendo ichak kompyuta kendo kapok itemo kendo. Ka idhi OK, programno biro weyo mondo ibed gi nyalo mar chako kendo.

err_auth_file_unusable_desc: Fail mar ng’eyo adier ma ne iyiero onge, onge gimoro kata ok nyal ndiko. Yier fail ma tiyo, kata igole e Sete, kae to flash kendo.

err_driver_missing_title: Draiva mar USB mar mediatek dwarore

1. Ket ng’wech mari kuom mako baton mar Power.
2. Ka Rockbox ochako tiyo, rie kebo mar USB e kompyuta mari.
3. Ka ng’ato onyisi e skrin mar ng’at ma ng’iyo gik moko, ng’e ni ng’atno nigi USB mondo onen kaka ng’at ma ng’ado gik moko.
